title: Forward Deployed AI Solutions Engineer
description:
About the role

The Forward Deployed Solutions Engineer will work directly within a business domain (e.g., Commercial, Clinical Operations, Lab Operations, Sales & Marketing, Customer Experience etc.). In your role, you’ll find opportunities for enhancing efficiency and productivity by looking for workflows which can be executed 10–100x faster or more often than a human team could using AI agents, integrations and other patterns. You will build, deploy, and run them in production.

You report into the central AI & Automation team, partner directly with domain leadership on priorities, and bring patterns back so the whole company compounds.

Find the leverage in your domain

  • Map the workflows in your domain — the ones running today, and the ones that don’t exist yet because they weren’t feasible without agents or automation tools.
  • Identify the step-change opportunities: where AI, ML, or automation unlock throughput, coverage, or speed.
  • Build the business case, quantify projected impact, and align with domain leadership on priorities. 

Design the future-state workflow

  • Map structured and unstructured data flows across the systems involved (CRM, ERP, ticketing, document stores, internal tools, external SaaS).
  • Define the target workflow: what the agent does, what the human does, and where they hand off.
  • Figure out what context the agent or model needs to do the work well — and how to get it there reliably (retrieval, grounding, tool access, memory).
  • Design human-in-the-loop checkpoints so review adds value without becoming the bottleneck.

Build and connect the systems

  • Stand up agents and automation pipelines using the organization’s approved AI platforms and frameworks.
  • Connect agents to business systems — via MCP servers, APIs, webhooks, CLIs, and skills — within the guardrails set by IT and security.
  • Configure tools, prompts, context, and retrieval pipelines so agents perform reliably on real work, not just in demos.
  • Handle integration gnarliness: auth, schema drift, rate limits, data quality, and the messy last-mile of enterprise systems.
  • Enable access and training for business to run the workflows

Run agents and automation pipelines in production

  • Own agent performance end-to-end. Track the KPIs that matter — throughput, quality, cost, human intervention rate, cycle time, adoption.
  • Build and manage evals. Re-run them on any material model, data, or workflow change before it ships.
  • Triage failures, tune prompts and context, iterate on the workflow, and retire agents when they’re no longer the right tool.
  • Instrument observability: tracing, structured logs, dashboards. You don’t ship what you can’t see.

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on technical fluency. CLIs, APIs, webhooks, SQL, and Python scripting. Working knowledge of LLM and agent behavior — prompting, context, tool use, RAG, MCP, evals, failure modes. Be very comfortable with a cloud platform.
  • Trustworthy with elevated access. Least-privilege, auditability, and safe rollbacks are second nature.
  • Strong technical and process judgment. You think in outcomes and KPIs, can defend prioritization calls, and are comfortable being the most technical person in a business meeting and the most business-savvy in a technical one.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience working hand in hand with businesses to deliver measurable outcomes.
  • Hands-on experience with an enterprise agentic platform (CrewAI, LangChain, AWS Bedrock, Claude, Codex) or building directly against a model API.
  • Background in product management, solutions engineering, consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or technical operations.
  • Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, GxP, SOX).

Success in year one

  • Shipped three or more workflows into production that are measurably moving a business KPI, with agent evals and observability in place.
  • Domain leadership brings you into planning early, not late.
  • Contributed at least one reusable asset another engineer on the team is now using.
  • Enabling non builders to become builders using the artifacts you created.

Compensation Ranges:

The base salary range for standard cost of living areas is: $105,700-$132,100

Higher cost of living areas: $116,200 - $145,300

Lower cost of living areas: $95,100-$118,900

Additional components such as bonus and equity are also included in this role.

 

The pay range is listed and actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications and specific office location. This may differ in other locations due to cost of labor considerations.
Remote USA
$105,700—$132,100 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply, and will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, age, veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable laws.

If you are based in California, we encourage you to read this important information for California residents. 

Link: https://www.natera.com/notice-of-data-collection-california-residents/

Please be advised that Natera will reach out to candidates with a @natera.com email domain ONLY. Email communications from all other domain names are not from Natera or its employees and are fraudulent. Natera does not request interviews via text messages and does not ask for personal information until a candidate has engaged with the company and has spoken to a recruiter and the hiring team. Natera takes cyber crimes seriously, and will collaborate with law enforcement authorities to prosecute any related cyber crimes.

Working closely with HR, Finance, IT and business stakeholders, you'll analyse business requirements, develop reporting and dashboards, identify opportunities for process improvement, and support the ongoing evolution of our Workday environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain Workday reports, dashboards and calculated fields to meet business needs.
  • Develop insightful Power BI dashboards using Workday and other data sources.
  • Analyse workforce data and trends to support strategic decision making.
  • Produce accurate management information and reporting for HR, Finance and senior leadership.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business processes, data quality and system adoption.
  • Support Workday configuration changes, testing and release activities.
  • Work with IT, HR and third-party vendors to troubleshoot issues and implement enhancements.
  • Ensure data integrity and compliance with governance and security standards.
  • Provide user guidance and support on reporting and Workday functionality.

Skills & Experience

We're looking for someone with experience in many of the following:

  • Strong experience using Workday HCM, Advanced Workday Reporting experience (Advanced, Matrix, Composite and Dashboards), and Workday Prism experience (desirable).
  • Strong Power BI development and data visualisation skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Power Query, Lookups, formulas and data analysis)
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • High attention to detail with a focus on data accuracy

What You'll Bring

  • A passion for improving business processes through technology and data.
  • A collaborative approach with the confidence to challenge and influence stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial awareness and the ability to translate complex data into meaningful business insights.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with a desire to optimise systems and reporting.
  • Excellent organisational skills and the ability to deliver high-quality work to tight deadlines.
Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

title: Plasma Microwave Modelling Physicist (ECRH, Gyrotrons)
description: Proxima Fusion is hiring an Alpha Plasma Microwave Modeler in Munich to own the physics simulation pipeline connecting our gyrotron sources to plasma performance. You will model the propagation, polarization and absorption of millimeter waves in the Alpha stellarator, running ray-tracing and beam-tracing codes such as TRAVIS and RAYTRAX and validating against W7-X experimental data to drive the design of the Alpha ECRH launcher. You will model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive and build Python post-processing pipelines. It suits physicists with hands-on experience of an EC propagation or absorption code. WHAT YOU WILL DO Run ray-tracing and beam-tracing simulations of EC wave propagation and absorption using codes such as TRAVIS, RAYTRAX and more complex beam or full wave model codes Develop an integrated modeling framework that couples wave deposition to transport codes, enabling temperature and density profile optimization and validation of the heating scenario performance Build and maintain Python-based post-processing pipelines to automate scenario scanning and interface simulation outputs with the Alpha integrated design framework Model Electron Cyclotron Current Drive (ECCD) and assess its ability to modify rotational transform and equilibrium in the Alpha quasi-isodynamic configuration Contribute to design reviews, interface control documents, and technical reports to ensure simulation results are traceable and actionable WHO YOU ARE PhD (or equivalent demonstrated expertise) in plasma physics, applied physics, or a related field, with a focus on plasma-wave interactions or RF heating of magnetically confined plasmas Hands-on experience with at least one EC propagation or absorption code (TRAVIS, TORBEAM, C3PO, IPF-FD3D, or similar) Proficiency in Python for simulation scripting, data analysis, and visualization; comfort reading and modifying legacy Fortran or C/C++ code Systems-thinking mindset: able to translate physics outputs into engineering requirements and hardware constraints Strong team player, comfortable working across physics and engineering disciplines and with external academic partners BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO Build the machine that builds the machine . Join TechOps at the forefront of advanced manufacturing, we’re building the production system that will enable commercial fusion. The Production lines, tooling, and processes are being developed from the ground up; you'll create the ways of working, not inherit them. Work at the frontier of manufacturing technology . Bring your creativity to evaluate, qualify, and deploy processes with no industry playbook, every component you build and every process you shape goes directly into the core of the stellarator magnet technology. Do work that matters, and see it grow . The hardware you build is the product and your career grows with it, from prototyping and process development through quality and industrialization, alongside exceptional colleagues from around the world. Make an impact you can point to . In a small, fast-moving team, your calls on equipment, quality, and process directly shape how a world-class deep-tech company produces superconducting magnets with results visible on the shop floor, not buried in a slidedeck. WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. The real world is the next frontier, and at Metropolis, we are creating the artificial intelligence to make it responsive. Metropolis is seeking a CX Operations Enablement Specialist to serve as the operational translator and steward of our Customer Experience knowledge ecosystem. In this role, you will tear down process friction, embed our "Trust-First" support philosophy, and ensure our frontline human agents and AI support tools have access to highly accurate, empathetic, and actionable information. Partnering closely with Operations, Product, QA, Training, and AI Strategy teams, you will architect SOPs, manage our knowledge libraries, and empower support teams to drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) and deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

What you'll do

  • Serve as the operational owner of Customer Experience knowledge, managing the customer-facing Help Center and internal Knowledge Library
  • Lead the comprehensive teardown and rebuild of legacy SOPs, replacing rigid policies with workflows anchored in our core framework: Acknowledge, Empathize, Verify, Resolve
  • Build localized, compliant SOPs and decision trees for complex operational workflows, such as Dynamic Pricing disputes and 3rd-Party Reservation failures
  • Own, restructure, and maintain the Gladly CRM macro library (CX Answers) and FAQs to drive First Contact Resolution (FCR) while aligning with the Metropolis brand voice
  • Serve as the primary CX liaison to Operations Launch teams, ensuring localized knowledge assets and documentation are delivered prior to go-live for new locations
  • Act as the direct operational bridge to Experience Integrity and Government Relations to establish strictly compliant agent guardrails for regulatory-sensitive workflows
  • Structure organizational knowledge clearly so it can be effectively ingested and retrieved by our AI Agent (Parker) and internal LLMs
  • Partner with CX AI Content Analysts to close documentation gaps that cause AI hallucinations or routing failures
  • Conduct recurring knowledge audits to identify gaps, partnering with QA and Training to ensure operational alignment

  • Experience managing or maintaining knowledge bases, help centers, or complex SOP documentation systems such as Gladly, Zendesk, Guru, or Confluence
  • Experience in Customer Support, Customer Experience, or a fast-paced operational environment

description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. What we do: build the most AI-driven, innovative, forward-thinking platform for energy management. From optimizing resources to delivering cost-effective, exceptional customer experiences through advanced Customer Information Systems (CIS), billing, meter data management, CRM, and AI-driven communications, Kraken is powering the next wave of innovation in the energy industry. Why we do it: future energy will not look like energy as we know it today. We need to not just think about our future, but build for it. Now. You will play a key role in delivering Kraken's Human Design principles and Operating Model to transform our clients Operations, leading implementation through a hands-on, consultative approach. A strong understanding of Human Design principles and change management best practice is essential, as is the ability to influence leaders, navigate change with confidence and bring sharp project management and analytical skills. You are responsible for guiding clients through the Kraken migration framework (BOT method), mentoring internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational success and long-term sustainability of the target operating model. While operations will be your core focus, you’ll also need a solid grasp of broader retail functions – how data, comms and marketing interact with operations to shape customer outcomes and influence the success of the new model. While the primary focus is the C&I function, you’ll also need B2C experience to effectively support clients across the portfolio. When executed well, these transformations can feel truly magical – across the whole organisation, and most importantly, our clients’ customers. The SCDL role is to make sure that magic is felt. Key Responsibilities: what you'll do Consultative Leadership & Client Engagement: Lead client interactions through the entire BOT program lifecycle, providing hands-on consulting and fostering a learning environment by guiding clients to take ownership early in the migration process of the operational programme. Help mobilise and set up initiatives such as Operations Transformation Office (OTO - client’s internal change management team), Early Adopters and work closely with Kraken’s Tech Teams to enable a smooth transformation. Establish strong relationships within the client’s Senior Leadership team, acting as a trusted advisor and helping to shape, influence and unblock strategic decisions. Empower the client’s migration ‘Ambassadors’ to become champions of the model, ensuring the program’s long term adoption and accountability across the organisation. Shape planning so it aligns with the client’s goals and aspirations. Project Management: Guide the delivery of Kraken programmes – from Leadership Development to Skills Based Learning – by defining clear programme milestones that keep teams and stakeholders on track and organised. Partner tightly with internal Tech teams so operational and technical migrations run in lockstep, reducing friction and keeping delivery on track. Drive continuous improvement and iteration, tailoring solutions based on client-specific needs. Mentorship & Coaching: Cultivate future leadership by mentoring and coaching the client’s OTO and internal teams, enabling them to be successful in a Kraken powered organisation. Ensure that internal stakeholders, including the OTO team, are fully equipped to take over ownership of scaling the operational transformation, with formalised check-ins at agreed points. Support the creation of high performing teams, able to think, lead and problem solve and lead in keeping with agile, customer centric methodologies. Analytical & Problem-Solving: Utilise strong analytical skills to anticipate challenges, pre-empt pain points and intervene early on to course correct. Leverage client and Kraken data to identify red flags, understand cause-and-effect relationships, and drive corrective actions to improve client outcomes. Being able to correlate and articulate the connection between employee engagement and customer satisfaction, and how operational changes can impact cost to serve. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Influence: Collaborate with multiple teams and stakeholders both within Kraken and across client internal teams such as HR, Data, Marketing and Tech to provide clear guidance on program delivery and solutions while managing client expectations. Collaborate across departments to ensure that Kraken’s core offering aligns with client expectations. Ensure that operations never become a blocker to continued migration. Remain up to date with new features and products and ensure the client is trained and adopts new functionality. Driving Organisational Change: Lead cultural and operational transformations, embedding sustainable change within the client’s organisation, using Kraken’s Human Design approach. Champion the Kraken Operating model, ensuring the client’s operational structure evolves in alignment with best practices for both immediate and long-term success. Skills: what you'll have Exceptional project management skills, with the ability to work across multiple clients and fast-paced timelines. Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify risks, and proactively implement solutions. Proven influencing skills, with experience persuading senior leaders and driving adoption of new methodologies

title: Ingénieur R&D logiciel F/H
description: L’Université de technologie de Compiègne recrute un(e) ingénieur(e) R&D logiciel pour le laboratoire Biomécanique et Bioingénierie (BMBI) au sein du département Génie Biologique (GB). Ce recrutement intervient dans le cadre du projet de maturation CHRONOS soutenu par la SATT LUCTECH. Votre mission Contribuer activement à la conception logicielle d'un prototype innovant de mesure et de traitement de signaux HD-sEMG (électromyographie de surface haute densité). En tant qu’acteur/actrice clé du projet, vous serez engagé(e) dans un processus complet de création de « briques » technologiques : spécifications, programmation, caractérisation et qualifications expérimentales jusqu’aux tests de fiabilité en environnement réel. Vos activités Développement logiciel : concevoir et coder l'architecture logicielle (traitement des données de signaux complexes, communication entre dispositifs, développement de l'interface homme-machine (IHM)). Phase de Test & Validation : designer, planifier et suivre les phases de tests hardware/software du dispositif d’acquisition HD-sEMG en environnement réaliste. Recueil de données : participer activement aux campagnes de mesures expérimentales Gestion de projet : assurer le suivi des livrables en lien avec les exigences de la SATT Lutech et documenter les développements. Veille technologique : rester en alerte sur les nouveautés scientifiques et techniques afin d'optimiser le prototype. Contexte du projet Issu d’une collaboration entre l’UTC, Sorbonne Université et l’AP-HP, CHRONOS répond à un enjeu clinique fort : permettre une évaluation simple, rapide et précise des capacités musculaires grâce aux signaux HD-sEMG. Cette innovation ouvre de nouvelles perspectives pour le suivi de la récupération fonctionnelle, la détection précoce de la sarcopénie et l’évaluation de la performance en santé et en médecine du sport. La SATT LUTECH accompagne ce projet en finançant le développement d’un premier prototype pour accélérer sa maturation et préparer son transfert. Ce projet fait suite à plusieurs projets de recherche financés par : EIT Health, Mécénat des mutuelles AXA, Fondation de l’Avenir, AP-HP, ANR France relance 2030, UTC, IUIS SU. Informations complémentaires Dates pour candidater Du 04/09/2026 au 05/10/2026 Type de contrat et date prévisionnelle de recrutement Contrat à durée déterminée - durée prévue de 18 mois - à pourvoir dès que possible et jusqu’au 29/02/2028 au plus tard Salaire mensuel brut Selon expérience et financement Volume horaire 37 heures et 30 minutes par semaine - 1 607 heures par an Environnement et contexte de travail La personne recrutée intégrera l'axe de recherche « C2MUST » (Caractérisation et Modélisation personnalisée du système neuro-MUSculo-squeleTtique) du laboratoire BMBI (UMR CNRS 7338). Les activités de recherche du laboratoire BMBI concernent la Biomécanique et la Bioingénierie, plus particulièrement la Mécanique du Vivant et l'Ingénierie de la Santé. Le laboratoire est rattaché à l'Institut CNRS Ingénierie. L’objectif central du projet de recherche du laboratoire BMBI est de développer des modèles numériques et expérimentaux (in vitro ou in vivo) du vivant, capables de répondre aux enjeux de la médecine de demain, et de les faire dialoguer avec les données recueillies (via les modèles, sur patients, etc). Disposer de solides connaissances en informatique, instrumentation et électronique. Avoir une bonne maitrise du langage Python ou équivalent. Être sensible aux exigences liées aux développements de dispositifs médicaux. Être rigoureux(se), méthodique et doté(e) d'un fort esprit d'analyse. Être curieux(se), passionné(e) par l'innovation biomédicale, et faire preuve d'imagination et de créativité face aux défis techniques. Avoir une très bonne capacité à travailler en équipe au sein d'un environnement pluridisciplinaire (chercheurs, cliniciens, ingénieurs). Diplôme, formation et habilitation Diplôme : Bac+5 Domaine : génie informatique, systèmes embarqués ou génie biomédical / Bioingénierie, Développement logiciel, traitement du signal, bioingénierie, dispositifs médicaux. title: In Vivo Research Associate II, Konermann Lab
description:
About Arc Institute

Arc Institute is an independent nonprofit research organization at the interface of artificial intelligence and biology, working to accelerate scientific progress and understand the root causes of complex diseases. Founded in 2021 and based in Palo Alto, Arc partners with Stanford University, UC Berkeley, and UC San Francisco.

Unlike academia, our scientists have long-term funding and industry-like resources. Unlike industry, they're free to pursue high-risk, long-term research without commercial pressures. Arc's Technology Centers and Core Investigator labs work side by side, integrating experimental and computational biology under one roof to tackle problems neither could solve alone.

Our two Institute Initiatives reflect this model in action:

  • Virtual Cell Initiative: Building a full-stack virtual cell model to identify disease mechanisms and nominate drug targets,  accelerating the path from biological insight to clinical trials.
  • Alzheimer's Disease Initiative: Mapping the genes, pathways, and environmental factors behind Alzheimer's disease to develop drug candidates that address root causes.

More than 300 Arconauts work together at our Palo Alto headquarters, backed by substantial long-term philanthropic funding.

About the position

We are seeking an In Vivo Research Associate II to join the Konermann Laboratory at the Arc Institute.You will collaborate closely with experienced scientists to advance in vivo projects focused on understanding brain development.

This project builds on previous work in genome-scale CRISPR screening (Konermann et al., 2015; Biering et al., 2021; Wei et al., 2023; Roohani et al., 2025) and aims to combine modern functional genomics and neuroscience tools to investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying brain development and function. The ideal candidate will have experience in animal handling and colony management, intracerebral injections, sample processing for single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial pipelines, and imaging. This position offers an excellent opportunity for candidates considering PhD programs, as it involves participation in all stages of a research project under the guidance of an experienced scientist.

About You

  • You love science and learning. Whether it's a new field or a new bench technique, you stay curious and enjoy stepping outside your comfort zone.
  • You are detail-oriented. You're careful and diligent about documentation and good lab practice, and you like keeping things organized.
  • You collaborate and help others. Science is a team effort, and you take the initiative to pitch in.
  • You are a problem solver. Experiments rarely work the first time. You bring patience and confidence to complex technical troubleshooting.

 In this position, you will

  • Plan, execute, analyze, and troubleshoot experiments with a high degree of independence, with continued support from the rest of the team
  • Perform in vivo mouse experiments, including stereotaxic surgeries, as well as IV and IP injections
  • Collect and process tissue, including vibratome and/or cryostat sectioning, immunostaining, and imaging
  • Comply with federal, Arc, and local IACUC/AAALAC regulations governing animal research
  • Follow Arc's standards for code of conduct, safety, and the handling of hazardous materials, biological materials, and controlled substances
  • Analyze and present data at subgroup meetings and seminars
  • Maintain an organized, detailed lab notebook

Job Requirements

  • BS with 2+ years of relevant experience, or MS, in molecular biology, neuroscience, or another relevant field. Relevant experience includes independent lab work during undergraduate studies
  • Strong experience working with laboratory animals, including handling, restraint, and procedures under an approved protocol (intracranial, IV, and IP injections, as well as perfusions)
  • Detail-oriented, with excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Outstanding critical thinking and problem-solving skills
  • Strong oral and written communication skills
  • Highly motivated and curious, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative team
  • Ability to work some weekends as needed (days off can be swapped for weekdays

Preferred Skills

  • Prior experience with cloning via Gibson assembly or Golden Gate protocols (library cloning experience is a plus)
  • Knowledge of and experience with NGS library preparation, particularly single-cell and spatial workflows
  • Computational skills (Python or R)

The base salary for this position is $75,900. This amount does not include benefits or other forms of compensation.

description: About us Eli Health is making continuous hormone monitoring possible so users can support their daily and long-term health. No more waiting days to track key biomarkers—get results you can use within minutes. Eli’s flagship product, Hormometer®, is the first instant hormone monitoring platform to deliver results from saliva to mobile app—anytime, anywhere. Developed over six years of R&D, over 2,000 product iterations, and backed by a dozen patent-pending innovations, Eli’s award-winning platform turns hormones into measurable signals you can track and improve. Just as the thermometer and glucometer have transformed health for millions, Eli’s platform is poised to be the next major evolution in tracking changes in stress, endurance, sleep, and more. About the role Eli is looking for a Software QA to join our product team full-time, starting as soon as possible. You’ll be the voice of the customer within the team: working closely with product and design to ensure what we ship matches what we designed, and that the experience stays high as the app evolves, release after release. For this role, we need someone who solves engineering problems well, notices what others miss, and is comfortable enough in code to keep an automated test suite healthy. Your primary responsibilities will include: Verifying features against their design specs and acceptance criteria, and catching the deltas between what was designed vs. what was built. Owning the bug backlog in Jira with the team’s support: reproducing, documenting, and prioritizing issues so the backlog shrinks rather than grows. Maintaining and expanding our automated end-to-end test suite (Maestro) to cover every critical scenario across iOS and Android. Keeping those tests stable in our CI pipelines (GitHub Actions): investigating failures, fixing flaky tests yourself, and flagging real regressions fast. Testing releases by hand on real devices to catch the usability and edge-case issues automation can’t. Working with developers, designers and product to build quality into features before the code is written. About you You have already shown that you go beyond the minimum: relevant work experience, side projects, or school projects that went beyond what the course asked. You solve varied engineering problems well, and that matters to us more than any specific tool. You’re meticulous, you like finding what’s wrong and explaining it clearly, and you can read and write code. You’re fluent in English and based in Montreal. Why you’ll love working at Eli You’ll work with a group of talented and mission-driven people eager to improve lifelong health at scale. description:
Revolution Medicines is a global, commercial-state oncology company dedicated to discovering, developing and delivering innovative medicines for patients with RAS-addicted cancers. Leveraging its differentiated RAS(ON) tri-complex inhibitor platform, the company is advancing a broad, integrated portfolio of oral RAS(ON) inhibitors designed to directly target the active, cancer-driving state of RAS. Founded on rigorous scientific inquiry and a willingness to challenge long-held assumptions, Revolution Medicines is committed to changing the trajectory of disease for patients with RAS-addicted cancers worldwide.

The Opportunity:

In this role, you will work within our Translational Medicine group analyzing and interpreting molecular and clinical data. Analysis will focus on using genomic, protein and other targeted assays to identify and validate predictive biomarkers. The computational clinical scientist will work on various projects in different phases of drug development and contribute to the cross-functional team which includes other bioinformaticians, program leads, medical monitors, biostatisticians other pre-clinical scientists.

  • Proficiency in visualizations and faceting of molecular data necessary (oncoplots, heatmaps, PCA, etc.).

Foresight Diagnostics is a molecular diagnostics company pioneering non-invasive cancer detection through highly sensitive, cell-free DNA-based liquid biopsy technologies. Our Mission

Our mission is to restore cell health and resilience through cell rejuvenation to reverse disease, injury, and the disabilities that can occur throughout life.

For more information, see our website at altoslabs.com.

Our Value

Our Single Altos Value: Everyone Owns Achieving Our Inspiring Mission.

Diversity at Altos

Altos Labs has been named one of the Top 3 Biotech Companies and ranked for the second year on the Forbes 2026 Best Startups in America list.  At Altos, exceptional scientists and industry leaders from around the world work together to advance a shared mission. Our intentional focus is on Belonging, so that all employees know that they are valued for their unique perspectives. We are all accountable for sustaining a diverse and inclusive environment.

What You Will Contribute To Altos

We are seeking an exceptional and versatile Scientist to join Discovery Science at Altos Labs. This role is ideal for a creative experimental scientist with deep expertise in in vivo and ex vivo disease biology who is excited to characterize and validate novel interventions for improving cell resilience and rejuvenating tissue functions.

The successful candidate will help develop and apply animal disease models for characterizing novel interventions, with opportunities to contribute across areas such as target discovery and validation, in vivo screening, and tissue-level functional assessment. 

We are looking for broadly capable scientists with strong technical depth, scientific creativity, and the curiosity to pursue new biological frontiers in a highly collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Design and execute innovative research strategies to identify causal regulators of cell state, aging, regeneration, and disease biology.
  • Develop and apply robust experimental workflows connecting genetic perturbation to molecular and phenotypic readouts across cellular and animal models.
  • Support genomic and molecular profiling methods, including transcriptome, proteome and single-cell readouts, to uncover novel biological mechanisms.
  • Translate in vitro discoveries into in vivo systems through the design and execution of hands-on mouse studies in relevant disease models.
  • Collaborate closely with computational scientists and cross-functional teams to integrate multidimensional datasets and generate actionable biological insight.
  • Lead project strategy, experimental design, execution, troubleshooting, and data interpretation.
  • Contribute to publications, patents, and broader scientific strategy.

Who You Are 

  • PhD in Biology, Stem cell, Aging, Physiology, or related field, with relevant postdoctoral and/or industry experience preferred.
  • Strong track record of scientific accomplishment through publications, patents, or impactful platform development.
  • Demonstrated expertise in the following areas:
    • Hands-on in vivo experience with disease mouse models.
    • Disease cell and mechanistic biology
  • Ability to independently lead complex research projects from concept to execution.
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to derive biological insight from multidimensional datasets.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work effectively in highly collaborative, interdisciplinary environments.
  • Scientific rigor, creativity, and comfort operating in rapidly evolving areas.

Minimum Qualifications

title: Scientist, LNP-Lipid Chemistry
description:
Company info

NewLimit is a biotechnology company working to radically extend human healthspan. We’re developing medicines to treat aging by reprogramming the epigenome, a new therapeutic mechanism to restore youthful function in aged cells. We’ve built the world’s leading experimental and artificial intelligence system to discover reprogramming medicines at massive scale. Our first products are focused on restoring youthful metabolic, endothelial, and immune function.

Description

NewLimit is seeking a Lipid Chemist to design, synthesize, and characterize ionizable lipids, PEG-lipid Conjugates, peptide and antibody conjugates to build our targeting LNP platform with a particular focus on getting nucleic acid payloads into target cells and tissues beyond the liver.

This is a hands-on bench role with real lipid design ownership. You will work closely with the Delivery Sciences and biology teams to design and build relevant Ionizable and targeting lipids portfolio for New Limit’s pipeline programs.

 

What you’ll do

  • Design new ionizable lipids and lipid conjugates for antibodies, peptides, and other targeting moieties across multiple structural families, pushing the platform beyond current-generation materials.
  • Devise and execute practical synthetic routes to priority targets to support NewLimit’s pipeline needs for targeting lipids.
  • Plan synthesis and purification for these modalities with scale and final purity in mind from the outset, delivering against agreed project timelines.
  • Build ionizable and targeting lipids for the tLNP platform using an SAR-based approach to guide the next design cycle rather than simply cataloging results.
  • Develop conjugation chemistry that links peptides, antibodies, nanobodies, and small-molecule ligands to lipid anchors, generating building blocks for cell- and tissue-selective delivery to support tLNP research and pipeline targets.
  • Turn in vitro and in vivo data from discovery teams into concrete structural hypotheses and revised molecules.
  • Present synthetic strategy, experimental results, and SAR conclusions, authoring protocols and technical reports.

Requirements

  • PhD in Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Chemistry, or a related discipline, plus 1–2 years of relevant work; or an MS with 5 years of focused lipid design experience for liposomal or lipid nanoparticle applications.
  • Strong skill set in the design and synthesis of new lipids or other delivery chemistries, performed personally rather than with a supervisor directing each step.
  • SAR-driven design, synthesis, purification, and characterization of ionizable lipids and PEG-lipid conjugates, using tools such as ChemDraw, Sci-Finder, Reaxsys, and AI-based SAR prediction tools for tLNP applications.
  • Working knowledge of conjugation chemistries for attaching targeting moieties such as peptides, antibodies, nanobodies, and small-molecule ligands, including linker design and the selection of suitable biorthogonal or site-specific handles.
  • Practical purification skills spanning normal- and reverse-phase chromatography and preparative HPLC.
  • Analytical characterization across LC-CAD, LC-UV, LC-MS/MS, and NMR (¹H, ¹³C, and ³¹P as needed), with the ability to deconvolute the data to produce well-characterized lipids.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with lipid degradation pathways and impurity work such as N-oxides, hydrolysis products, and lipid–nucleic acid adducts, and how they affect potency and stability.
  • Solid-phase peptide synthesis, or antibody/nanobody modification experience.
  • Exposure to scale-up, CMC, or tech transfer to a CDMO.
  • Experience with data visualization and statistical analysis (R, Python, JMP)

Benefits

  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Paid parental leave.
  • Industry-leading PTO: 20 days per year plus holidays.

* This job does not qualify and/or is not eligible for sponsorship.

The Accessioning Team Runner collects, sorts, and transports packages to Accessioning laboratory.   This position is located on site in our Pleasanton, CA location.  Schedules listed below and pay starts at $20.    
 
Schedule:  Tuesday - Saturday, 630am-3pm.  Hourly pay starts at $20.

 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sort and transport packages from the Shipping dock to the Accessioning laboratory.

  • Pick up packages from the receptionist’s desk.

  • Scan all tracking numbers into a Google spreadsheet and ensure that tracking numbers are scanned in correctly and spreadsheet is filled out completely.

  • Distribute packages to the Clinical Data Operators (CDO) in a timely and efficient manner following distribution guidelines.

  • Rack samples that arrive in bulk (without individual kit boxes) ensuring that the paperwork matches up with the samples.

  • Escalate any issues or discrepancies to the Leads or Supervisor.

  • Empty bins filled with kit boxes at the CDO workstations into carts placed at designated locations in the lab.

  • Perform a visual check of the kit boxes to make sure that there is no PHI on the kit boxes or samples remaining in the discarded kit boxes.

  • Empty biohazard cans in the lab.

  • Scan bench worksheets.

  • Scan documents into cases.

  • Maintain tidiness of Runner workstations.

  • Store requisition forms by date into the filing cabinets.

  • Dispose of requisition forms into the shred bins that have exceeded the retention period.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Notify Supervisor and Leads of any packaging issues or discrepancies

  • This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and has access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job

  • Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

  • Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

 

  • QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma (or equivalent) required.

  • Previous computer experience.

  •  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Familiar with Google documents.

  • Ability to perform basic calculations.

  • Organized and self- motivated.

  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently.

 

Compensation & Total Rewards 

This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base pay we reasonably expect to offer at the time of  hire. Final compensation will vary based on experience, qualifications, and skills considerations.

This position is also eligible for additional compensation and benefits through Natera’s robust Total Rewards program, including:

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Generous paid time off and company holidays

  • Additional wellness and work-life benefits

Compensation Range
$16.50—$20.63 USD

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Everlywell is a digital health company pioneering the next generation of biomarker intelligence—combining AI-powered technology with human insight to deliver personalized, actionable health answers. We transform complex biomarker data into life-changing insights—seamlessly integrating advanced diagnostics, virtual care, and patient engagement to reshape how and where health happens.

Fueled by AI and built for scale, we’re breaking down barriers, closing care gaps, and unlocking a more connected healthcare experience that is smarter, faster, and more personalized.


Everlywell's mission is to transform lives with modern, diagnostics-driven care, and we believe that the future of healthcare is meeting people where they are. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, Everly Health is the parent company to Everlywell, Everly Health Solutions, Everly Diagnostics, PWN Health, and Natalist. We've set a new standard of people-focused, diagnostic-driven care that puts patients at the center of their own health journey. 
 
Our infrastructure guides the full testing experience with the support of a national clinician network that's composed of hundreds of physicians, nurses, genetic counselors, PharmDs, and member care specialists. Our solutions make world-class virtual care more attainable with rigorous clinical protocols and best-in-class science to tackle some of the healthcare industry's biggest problems.
 
We are a digital health company pioneering the next generation of biomarker intelligence—combining technology with human insight to deliver personalized, actionable health answers. ROLE SUMMARY
The Medical Laboratory Technologist supports accurate, timely, and reliable clinical laboratory testing. The technologist works closely with the leadership and laboratory team to maintain quality, investigate testing issues, document corrective actions, and ensure that patient results are not released until the testing system is functioning within established performance specifications.

POSITION SUMMARY:

 

The Supervisor of the clinical laboratory is a member of the Operations Department whose role is to oversee employees' performance and serve as a liaison between employees and senior management to meet company goals and quality objectives. Duties include but are not limited to coaching, motivating, staffing, evaluating, and training staff. The supervisor works closely with the manager to ensure company and team goals are met while adhering to good manufacturing practices and CLIA/CAP guidelines.

description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
 
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
 
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
 
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
Veeva Ostro sits at the intersection of life sciences, marketing, and artificial intelligence. We empower pharmaceutical brands, healthcare providers (HCPs), and patients by orchestrating AI-enabled omnichannel engagement across the entire patient and prescriber lifecycle.
 
As the Data Analytics Lead, you will own the data systems and associated measurement analyses that sit at the intersection of our products, customers, and commercial strategy. Our products generate significant data as users ask questions and take action, and you will work with the product team to surface and execute on insights that govern how our product evolves. This data is also used by our customers in their planning efforts, and you will work closely with our client service and implementation teams to enable and deliver on customized analyses that reflect the nuances of each client’s strategy. To deliver on the above, you will proactively architect, build, and scale the next generation of our data platform to make it modern, scalable, and AI-ready.

title: Accessioning Team Runner
description:
POSITION SUMMARY - On site position in Austin, TX 

* This job does not qualify and/or is not eligible for sponsorship.

The Accessioning Team Runner collects, sorts, and transports packages to Accessioning laboratory.   This position is located on site in our Austin, TX location.  Schedules listed below and pay starts at $17.    
 
Schedule:  Tuesday - Saturday, 10am-630pm 
  

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Sort and transport packages from the Shipping dock to the Accessioning laboratory.

  • Pick up packages from the receptionist’s desk.

  • Scan all tracking numbers into a Google spreadsheet and ensure that tracking numbers are scanned in correctly and spreadsheet is filled out completely.

  • Distribute packages to the Clinical Data Operators (CDO) in a timely and efficient manner following distribution guidelines.

  • Rack samples that arrive in bulk (without individual kit boxes) ensuring that the paperwork matches up with the samples.

  • Escalate any issues or discrepancies to the Leads or Supervisor.

  • Empty bins filled with kit boxes at the CDO workstations into carts placed at designated locations in the lab.

  • Perform a visual check of the kit boxes to make sure that there is no PHI on the kit boxes or samples remaining in the discarded kit boxes.

  • Empty biohazard cans in the lab.

  • Scan bench worksheets.

  • Scan documents into cases.

  • Maintain tidiness of Runner workstations.

  • Store requisition forms by date into the filing cabinets.

  • Dispose of requisition forms into the shred bins that have exceeded the retention period.

  • Performs other duties as assigned.

  • Notify Supervisor and Leads of any packaging issues or discrepancies

  • This role works with PHI on a regular basis both in paper and electronic form and has access to various technologies to access PHI (paper and electronic) in order to perform the job

  • Employee must complete training relating to HIPAA/PHI privacy, General Policies and Procedure Compliance training and security training as soon as possible but not later than the first 30 days of hire.

  • Must maintain a current status on Natera training requirements.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma (or equivalent) required.

  • Previous computer experience.

  •  

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

  • Familiar with Google documents.

  • Ability to perform basic calculations.

  • Organized and self- motivated.

  • Ability to work quickly and efficiently.

 

 

 

 

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

For more information, visit www.natera.com.

Natera is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. title: Designer
description:
We invite you to come grow with us.

Inizio Ignite is the global advisory partner for health and life sciences, bringing together connected expertise across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic and STEM. Guided by purpose, passion and precision, we connect insight, strategy and execution to help clients make stronger decisions, accelerate performance and deliver lasting impact for patients. Data, technology and AI enhance this work, alongside the human expertise and judgement that define our advisory offer.

About the India Design Studio

We are establishing an India Design Studio in Gurugram to support Inizio Ignite's global teams. The studio will operate as a central design hub, working with business-unit spokes across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and Innovation & Growth.

The Design Studio will turn complex strategic, scientific and commercial content into clear, persuasive client stories. It will support high-value business development and client-facing work, including proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, credentials, case studies, thought leadership and other priority materials.

Our goal is to improve the quality, speed and consistency of these materials; strengthen how Ignite presents its connected expertise; and build reusable design assets and ways of working that support client delivery and growth.

How quality works in the studio

Quality is shared. Everyone who creates or edits work is accountable for the accuracy and quality of their contribution. Designers complete a structured self-check before handover. The Production & QA Assistant provides independent, checklist-based review and delivery control. The Senior Designer provides creative oversight and final design sign-off for priority or high-risk work. Business stakeholders remain accountable for factual content, client requirements and final business approval.

 

How we use AI

Approved AI and automation tools may be used to support brief understanding, content structuring, asset discovery, layout exploration, tagging and quality checks. They are enabling tools rather than substitutes for design craft. Human judgement, confidentiality, accessibility, brand integrity and final accountability always come first.

 

Your primary role

Designer - India Design Studio

This role is a developing presentation designer who delivers high-quality, client-facing work within agreed standards and timelines. You will improve the clarity, structure and visual impact of proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks and related materials, while building the judgement and independence required to progress in the team.

What you will do

  • Design and redesign slides, proposal sections, RFP materials, credentials and case studies to improve clarity, visual hierarchy, structure and readability.
  • Apply Inizio Ignite brand standards, PowerPoint templates, visual systems and document standards consistently.
  • Translate clear briefs and developed content into polished visual outputs, escalating gaps or ambiguity early.
  • Adapt existing materials for different audiences, clients, geographies and pursuit contexts.
  • Create reusable slides, diagrams, icons and data visuals.
  • Work with the design team and the Senior Designer on more complex visual storytelling and priority pursuits.
  • Own the quality of your work, complete the studio self-check and resolve issues identified through design review or independent QA.
  • Maintain clean, editable, accessible, well-named and version-controlled files that are ready for handover and reuse.
  • Use approved AI tools responsibly where they improve understanding, exploration or efficiency, while applying independent design judgement to every output.
  • Contribute to asset tagging, template improvement, knowledge capture and shared ways of working.

About you

Your skills and experience

  • Around 2-4 years of experience in presentation design, graphic design, visual design or a similar role, ideally supporting proposals, pitches, RFPs or other client-facing materials.
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong layout, visual hierarchy, slide design, brand application and the ability to make complex content easier to understand.
  • Strong PowerPoint skills and working knowledge of Adobe Creative Cloud, Figma or comparable design tools; Think-cell or other charting experience would be useful.
  • Good understanding of typography, templates, design systems, iconography, data visualisation and document polish.
  • Clear communication skills and the confidence to ask focused questions when briefs, priorities or source content are incomplete.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to manage several workstreams within agreed service levels.
  • Practical AI literacy and the judgement to review, refine or reject AI-assisted suggestions before use.
  • Experience with healthcare, life sciences, consulting or professional-services content would be advantageous.

Ideal profile

  • You enjoy turning rough or inconsistent content into clear, polished and client-ready materials.
  • You can work confidently within templates while bringing creativity, clarity and visual thinking.
  • You seek feedback, learn quickly and take increasing ownership as your skills develop.
  • You are collaborative, dependable and motivated to help build a new global design capability.

Career progression

This role sits within the Design Studio career framework of Production & QA Assistant, a Design team and Senior Designer. Progression to the next level is based on stronger independent ownership, visual storytelling, stakeholder management, delivery of more complex work and contribution to studio standards - not tenure alone.

 Life at Inizio Ignite

You will join a connected, global business where collaboration, curiosity, drive and agility shape how we work. We encourage people to bring their authentic selves, keep learning, challenge the status quo and do the right thing.

In the Design Studio, you will have the opportunity to help build a new capability, work with international teams and influence how Ignite presents its expertise to clients.

We provide

  • A learning culture with opportunities to develop design, technology, AI and healthcare knowledge.
  • International collaboration across Research Partnership, Putnam, Vynamic, STEM and wider Inizio teams.
  • A supportive, inclusive and friendly working environment where your contribution matters.
  • A visible career framework, supported by regular feedback, skills development and opportunities to take on greater complexity and responsibility.

Further information

This is a full-time role and is expected to follow a hybrid working pattern, based at our Inizio location in Gurugram. The role will support global teams across time zones, so flexibility to work within agreed UK- and US-aligned collaboration windows may be required. The exact reporting line, working pattern and hours will be confirmed during the recruitment process.

 

Don't meet every job requirement? That's okay! Our company is dedicated to building an inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role, but your experience doesn't perfectly fit every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this role or others.

description:
At Real Chemistry, making the world a healthier place isn’t just an aspiration—it’s our everyday reality. Discover your purpose. Embrace innovation. Experience #LifeatRealChem.

Job Summary:

Real Chemistry is looking for a Account Manager to join our growing team!

 

As an Account Manager, you will act as the key day-to-day client contact, managing relationships and taking responsibility for the delivery of several medium-sized projects. As a captain, you will be responsible for managing the execution of parallel ongoing projects and take an active role in coaching your junior team and ensuring projects are delivered effectively alongside the account lead.

 

 

What you’ll do:

Client delivery

  • Act as day-to-day client contact: provide regular status updates to your client; respond to client queries and share recommendations (following discussion with your account lead); manage client expectations on timelines, scope of project, etc.; take client briefs and clearly communicate to team members, implementing realistic project plans

  • Take responsibility for the day-to-day management of your account, including managing the processes of the account (including running regular internal team meetings), flow of work (review content developed by more junior team members), delegation of tasks (oversee status reports to ensure all team actions are complete) and the status of jobs across the account (not just your own)

  • Ownership of and accountability for medium-sized client projects, ensuring that projects are delivered to highest possible standards within budget and agreed timeframes

  • Actively demonstrate an understanding of your clients’ needs (building an awareness of their strategy and brand) and preferences in your interactions and the delivery of work

  • Confidently develop written content (briefing documents, etc) and gain experience reviewing junior team members’ work, ensuring content is accurate and developed to a high standard ahead of more senior review

 

Business development

  • Start to identify areas for growth (evolving existing programmes and/or additional tactics), proactively sharing new ideas with your team and client

  • Take an active role in new business, which may include undertaking and presenting research to the pitch team, or facilitating team input via brainstorms/presenting as part of the pitch team

 

Team management

  • Maintain an awareness of the professional development of more junior team members on your accounts, through regular catch ups and interactions

  • Develop your coaching, delegation and briefing (both internally and externally with suppliers) skills, and lead by example; use these approaches to upskill, develop and inspire more junior team members

  • Buddy new SAA/AM starters

 

Financial management

  • Develop a greater understanding of the account finances beyond your projects, proactively supporting your account lead with financial management including managing Salesforce opportunities, invoicing and forecasting

  • Develop accurate budgets for clients, reflecting on previous projects and gathering cost quotes

  • Manage the budget for projects that you own, feeding into your account lead as part of the broader programme finances; identify where project is going out of scope and alert your account lead with details of additional budget required

  • Input into the resourcing process by sharing with your account/medical writer lead the requirements for your projects

  • Complete your timesheets and expense claims accurately and on time and take an active role in reviewing timesheets across some of your projects

 

Agency environment

  • Participate in internal initiatives which contribute to the culture or development of the Medical Communications team, or Real Chemistry more broadly (e.g., compliance/socials/inspiration)

  • Immerse yourself in the medical communications and pharma industries, and your client companies and therapy areas: engage with every opportunity to establish an awareness of developments, innovations and trends. Look for opportunities to reflect these in your work and flag your ideas to your teams and wider team to raise your internal profile

 

 

This position is a perfect fit for you if:

  • ​Our Company values – Best Together, Impact-Obsessed, Excellence Expected, Evolve Always and Accountability with an “I” – really speak to you.

  • You are adaptable, resilient, and OK with adjusting your scope, responsibilities, and focus as we grow. When things change, so do we. We’re always evolving.

  • You are proactive, driven, and resourceful with strong prioritization skills and a desire to dive into the data.

  • You are highly organized self-starter, able to work independently and under tight deadlines.

 

 

What you should have:

  • Relevant degree in a scientific subject

  • Highly organised with a mindfulness of deadlines, the ability to manage multiple tasks based on priorities and a strong attention to detail

  • Independent thinker confident in taking ownership of assets and material development, but a team player who enjoys collaboration

  • Ability to mentor junior staff and delegate accordingly in order to achieve project deadlines

  • Has confidence to manage upward when required; able to communicate with managers when deadlines will not be met or when issues are foreseeable

  • Demonstrated strong work ethic, with a track record of following through on client requests and with high-quality deliverables on schedule and on budget

  • Ability to develop project scopes and vendor contracts

  • Excellent business communication ability, including informal/formal presentation and writing skills

  • High energy, able to effectively operate in fast-paced, growing and evolving environment

title: Hydrographer/Geophysicist
description: The Role We are the explorers. We are the builders. We are the Wayfinders. Bedrock is mapping the unseen world beneath our oceans and building the systems to do it at scale. We're hiring a Hydrographer/Geophysicist to work with some of the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet. You'll process and analyze multibeam, sidescan, magnetometer, and sub-bottom data from Bedrock field tests and commercial operations, and you'll own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality. When something looks strange in a dataset, you'll be the person asking what it tells us about the vehicle, the survey plan, or the seafloor itself. You will also be in front of customers discussing data quality, interpretation, and deliverables, and teaching them how to read what they're seeing and what it's worth. This is a role for someone who relishes that part of the job. And you'll be on the leading edge of the field. Bedrock is working with major governments around the world on how uncertainty and accuracy should be defined in ocean data- literally helping write the book, the policy, and the guidelines. This is the team revolutionizing how the seafloor gets characterized, and you'd have a say in what the next decade of this field looks like. We are hiring for curiosity, speed of learning, and real excitement about seeing the seafloor in higher fidelity than anyone has seen it before. If you have most of what's below and you're hungry to learn the rest, we want to talk to you. What You'll Do Data Processing & Quality First-pass analysis of MBES, SSS, magnetometer, and/or sub-bottom profiler data using commercial software (Qimera, Seaview, SonarWiz, Radex, etc.) Own rapid, iterative feedback on data quality- first pass gets us information, not perfection Spot artifacts and anomalies, and reason about what caused them Work with Bedrock leadership and customers to hold the highest data quality standard in the industry Clients & Education Create data products and write-ups for commercial clients Serve as a primary point of contact for data quality issues, interpretations, and deliverables Teach clients about the unique value of AUV data, and what they can do with it- bring them on the journey rather than handing over a file Explain trade-offs, limitations, and uncertainty clearly, directly, and without defensiveness The Leading Edge Contribute to how uncertainty and accuracy get defined in ocean data-work that feeds into government standards, policy, and guidelines Collaborate with product and engineering on iterative improvements to the vehicle and to survey planning Help build the processing workflows that let all of this scale Who You Are You're a curious, fast-learning data person who wants to be on the vanguard of ocean data, and who would rather be in the conversation with the customer than behind it. Experience Experience processing and reporting on at least two of: MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler, using commercial software Comfort with ArcGIS, QGIS, and/or AutoCAD Experience writing data reports for commercial clients Attention to detail- you find the artifact nobody else saw Nice to Have Experience across all four relevant sensor types (MBES, SSS, magnetometer, sub-bottom profiler) Light coding (Python/SQL) Offshore experience (ship or AUV ops) Certified Hydrographer, Cat A or Cat B; Licensed Surveyor Experience across defense (mine countermeasures, unexploded ordnance), energy (oil & gas, offshore wind), and/or environmental survey How You Operate You learn fast, and you ask good questions when you are uncertain You treat processing as a problem-solving activity, not a checkbox exercise Iterative by instinct, you improve the data and the workflow with every pass Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities change You use tools and AI to increase speed, accuracy, and leverage You are comfortable, clear, and collaborative in front of a customer What You Care About The idea of seeing the seafloor in a way no one has seen it before excites you You take pride in craft, clarity, and accuracy You have some connection to the ocean, professional, academic, or personal and you are excited to be around people who dive, sail, build, and explore offshore Not a Fit If... You want the data perfect on the first pass-iterative improvement is our way You are uncomfortable with uncertainty or with rapid changes in priorities You are not interested in learning new tools and approaches You do not want to interface directly with clients, or you see customer education as a distraction from the real work You are looking for predictable hours and firm boundaries around when the work happens. This job will require some nights and weekends around survey campaigns. Estimated compensation for this position is $95,000- $130,000 annually plus equity. Actual salary offered will be based on qualifications, experience, and location (SF and NY being at the high end of the band). If you want to work on the highest-resolution seafloor data on the planet and help decide what comes next in this field, we should talk.

title: PLOS One Associate Editor - Life Sciences
description:
*This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.

 In the US, this is a union represented position as part of the Pacific Media Workers Guild, Local 39521 of the NewsGuild-Communication Workers of America. 

Role Summary 

PLOS is a nonprofit organization on a mission to drive open science forward with measurable, meaningful change in research publishing, policy, and practice. We believe in a better future where science is open to all, for all.  

 The Associate Editor oversees the editorial process for manuscripts submitted to PLOS journals. This role will require the use of prior research experience, critical evaluation skills, and internal guidelines to make nuanced and complex editorial decisions. The Associate Editor works with colleagues in their division and other teams to deliver developmental and promotional activities for PLOS journals. 

 

Responsibilities 

  • Serve as a point of escalation for complex and nuanced editorial queries. 
  • Support other teams at PLOS, members of the editorial board, and third-party editorial teams to ensure high standards of scientific rigor and editorial integrity are upheld. 
  • Evaluate submissions and make decisions based on reviewers’ comments. 
  • Participate in activities to develop editorial policy and improve the visibility and reputation of journals in the PLOS portfolio. 
  • Handle publication ethics queries. 
  • Build relationships with members of the academic community. 
  • Demonstrate a positive, constructive attitude to change and a growth mindset. 

 

Knowledge and Skills 

  • Experience in a research environment, publishing, or other relevant industry. 
  • Highly organized and efficient, with strong critical assessment, and problem-solving abilities. 
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, both written and oral. 
  • Able to work under tight deadlines whilst achieving a high standard of quality and accuracy. 
  • Able to set priorities and work independently. 

 

Qualifications 

  • A PhD is required. 

 

Physical Requirements and Work Environment 

  • Prolonged periods stationary at a desk and working on a computer 
  • Some national and international travel may be required occasionally 
  • Some flexibility to work across time zones 

 

The base salary range we’ve established for these positions is (UK) £35,000 - £38,950 / (US) $67000 to $73,625. PLOS also offers a comprehensive benefits package summarized below.  

 

BENEFITS: 

US:

  • 401k with employer match
  • Employee sponsored health, dental and vision insurance (Dental and Vision 100% employer paid)
  • Paid Vacation, 11 public holidays and sick leave
  • Parental leave
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off
  • Short term and long term disability insurance
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office 

UK: 

  • Private medical insurance 
  • Life assurance 
  • Income protection  
  • Personal accident insurance 
  • Pension with up to 10% employer match 
  • 25 days holidays, market competitive Maternity and Paternity leave 
  • Birthday and three winter holidays days off 
  • 2 days paid time off for volunteering per year 
  • Fully remote work environment with stipend on joining for home office

About PLOS 

Building on a strong legacy of pioneering innovation, PLOS continues to be a catalyst in open science, reimagining models to meet open science principles, removing barriers and promoting inclusion in knowledge creation and sharing, and publishing research outputs that enable everyone to learn from, reuse and build upon scientific knowledge.

Our work is supported by a highly skilled global in-house team, partnerships with local scholarly organizations, and the valued contributions of a diverse, international community of scientific researchers.

We’re committed to equal opportunity

We’re working to create a more equitable system of scientific knowledge and understanding. Removing barriers to inclusion and facilitating broad participation of voices is core to our success, inside and out. 

Beyond accepting distinct perspectives, we seek and support divergent backgrounds among our staff because we know differences strengthen our teams, our work, and our communities. We strongly encourage applicants of all identities to join us as we work towards a future where science is open to all, for all. 

Visit plos.org/careers to learn more.

To learn more about how PLOS protects your privacy, see our Employee Privacy Notice.

Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.


The Role
We are looking for a skilled Account Partner to drive sales and customer success for Veeva LIMS to emerging and established biotechnology companies.

To be successful in this role, proactivity, strategic thinking, adaptability and working effectively within a growing team are critical.  You also must exhibit a collaborative, team-first work style and growth mindset.

We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.
